name: Skarnhold
description: Maldrath's fortress on its black island: eight levels of stone, poison and the Sovereign's creatures, with the Dawnglass at the bottom.

k1_hall.name: The Black Hall
k1_hall.description: A vast hall of black marble lit by braziers of green flame. Doors stand in the east and west walls, and a stair goes down at the far end.

west.failure_message: The west wing's door is locked. A brass key would answer it.

east.failure_message: The east wing's door is locked. A brass key would answer it.

k1_west.name: The West Wing
k1_west.description: A bare wing of cells and guardrooms. The air smells of cold iron.

k1_east.name: The East Wing
k1_east.description: A bare wing of storerooms and stairs. A heavy door stands open on dust.

k1_stair.name: The Great Stair
k1_stair.description: A broad, black stair spiralling down into the heart of the fortress.

k_b1_a.name: The Lower Hall
k_b1_a.description: A cold vaulted hall with a floor of black and white flags.

k_b1_b.name: The Guardroom
k_b1_b.description: A guardroom with a long table and no guards.

k_b2_a.name: The Cellar Way
k_b2_a.description: A damp stone corridor, running between rows of iron-barred cells.

k_b2_sword.name: The Sealed Chamber
k_b2_sword.description: A small, bare chamber behind a door that was never meant to be found. A single strongbox sits on a plinth in a shaft of light.

k_b2_stair.name: The Stair of Chains
k_b2_stair.description: A stair hung with rusted chains.

k_b3_a.name: The Hall of Banners
k_b3_a.description: A hall hung with banners of black cloth, each stitched with a single coiled drake.

k_b3_b.name: The Chapel of Ash
k_b3_b.description: A ruined chapel, its altar black, its windows bricked up.

k_b4_fork.name: The Fork
k_b4_fork.description: A broad landing where two stairs and two passages meet. From here, it is said, one can go back up toward a sealed chamber, or on down to the Sovereign.

k_b4_a.name: The Armoury
k_b4_a.description: An armoury of racks full of black weapons, rusted past use.

k_b4_stair.name: The Stair of Embers
k_b4_stair.description: A stair lit from below by a dull red glow.

k_b5_a.name: The Poisoned Gallery
k_b5_a.description: A gallery whose floor glows with a sickly blue-green light. Your feet burn where they touch it.

k_b5_b.name: The Burning Floor
k_b5_b.description: A narrow hall whose flags are slick with the same blue-green poison.

k_b5_stair.name: The Stair of Venom
k_b5_stair.description: A stair that is the only clean thing in sight.

k_b6_a.name: The Hall of Venom
k_b6_a.description: A great hall where the poison has pooled in the low places.

k_b6_b.name: The Last Gallery
k_b6_b.description: A gallery whose floor is as bad as the rest, and whose far end shows a door of black iron.

k_b6_stair.name: The Last Stair
k_b6_stair.description: A stair of black glass, going down to a single door.

k_b7_hall.name: The Anteroom of the Throne
k_b7_hall.description: A round chamber with a vaulted ceiling and a great door of black iron standing open on the south. Another, smaller door is locked in the west wall.

west.failure_message: The treasure room's door is locked. A brass key would answer it.

k_b7_throne.name: The Throne of Iron Thorns
k_b7_throne.description: A great round hall with a throne of black iron thorns on a dais. The Dawnglass burns in the air behind it like a small, captive sun.

k_b7_treasure.name: The Treasure Room
k_b7_treasure.description: A small, close room stacked with chests, and the faint, stale smell of a plan.
